column4: Fixed 2D side-facing fantasy battle, original forest backdrop.
Mounted lancer, broad shield, hood and bow, robed mage and lantern healer have different outlines.
Navy and gold allies, muted purple enemies, warm accents and cool scenery.
Original outlined vector figures and effects exist, but illustration detail falls short of the supplied detailed sprite reference; movement is procedural, not full sprite animation.
Sprite sheet was viewed and original silhouettes drawn; Campaign page returned HTTP 402, so exact reference content could not be checked.
Five units each side; formation slots 0-1 front and 2-4 back, swap by selecting cards; side panel describes selected ability.
Visible next actors, HP, damage; act() implements healing and shielding.
Five original hero roles; brute, archer, shaman, assassin and boss have distinct targeting or skills.
Config defines 2 chapters with 5 stages, progressive unlock and boss at each chapter end; only early stages were played.
Observed level 3 Aveline evolve to Tinh Anh; gold and four shards spent, HP/attack increased; act() improves evolved skills.
First-clear vs repeat reward rules, persistent storage with validation and writes after currency/formation changes; browser confirmed saves, reload persistence not separately exercised.
Procedural idle, attack motion, hit flash, death fade; victory screen observed in evidence/victory.png. Not a full sprite animation set.
Five allies against five enemies observed.
Actions execute without individual player commands via fixed-step queue.
Two upgrades consumed gold and experience, level 3 displayed.
One-tier evolution working and observed after clearing two stages.
Chapter and stage growth multiplies enemy stats, boss and later enemy behavior changes wired to stages.
Chapter 1 map starts with a full team and stage 1-1 selected.
Role cards and ordered automatic combat visible.
Rewards observed; renderUI result text guides upgrade, returnMap selects the next stage.
